about: The brain Eric last approved: its commit, the slates-api commit brain-approved.json pins with it (approvedApiCommit) and the brainHash (brain-hash.mjs) of what its build hands an agent. The plugins are built from this commit's skills (build-plugins.mjs), shared's publish refuses any other brain (brain-review.mjs --check), and the gate compares every candidate with a build of it in the same batch (gate.mjs). Only brain-review.mjs --approve moves them, with Eric's decisions exported from his review page; --pin-approved-hash records the hash once when it is missing. lastApproval is what that approval took: the page's head, what he approved and held, the reverts and the gate's report.

gate: craft claude-opus-5-5: the candidate wins 12 cases, loses 8, ties 5 against the approved brain (an equal brain loses that many or more 87% of the time); craft 1.55 against 1.52 of 2, read before building 96% against 94%, playbook 92% against 90%, forbidden 0 against 0
